plan: A grumpy yordle on his lizard who charges and drags his enemy with a bear trap.
aSurveiller: His Q (Bear Trap on a Rope). It hooks onto you then pulls you to him: move away quickly to break the rope.
contrer: Move away quickly when his trap (Q) hooks you: otherwise he pulls you to him.
When he loses his lizard, attack him: he is very weak on foot.
Spread out from his charge (R): it crosses the map towards you.
forces: Two health bars with his lizard.
His R engages from very far.

sorts.P: Rides a lizard that takes damage for him.
sorts.Q: Trap that hooks on then pulls the target.

momentFort: Strong from the start of the game.
